html:
Step into mythological Egypt in Horus: Desert Survivor, a survivor-like action game with deckbuilding at its core. Play as Horus and fight through endless hordes, corrupted gods, and mythical beasts as you seek vengeance and restore balance to your father’s fallen land.

Face relentless waves of enemies, from twisted deities to monstrous creatures. Master fast-paced combat, unleash divine powers, and cleanse the fallen as each encounter grows more dangerous and demanding.

Build your arsenal through strategic deckbuilding. Collect magical weapons, divine artifacts, and ancient training to create powerful synergies. Every choice shapes your build, your playstyle, and your chances of survival.

Forge your destiny across ancient temples, cursed lands, and the unforgiving desert. Make impactful decisions, unlock new powers, and determine Horus’ fate. Will you succumb to corruption, or rise as a god?
